hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}" 2>/dev/null; date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S session-start fired' >> /tmp/graphify-session.log; (sh scripts/graphify-refresh.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &); exit 0

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] || (sh scripts/setup-graphify.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &); exit 0
